title.en: Index numbers: meaning, construction and uses

heading.en: How much costlier is life today?

hook.en: Your grandparents bought rice at a few rupees a kilo. To compare prices across years, statisticians use one number: the index number.
hook.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅಜ್ಜ-ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಕೆಲವೇ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಕಿಲೋ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಎಂಬ ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

objectives.en: Define an index number and a price relative
List the problems in constructing an index number
State the uses and limitations of index numbers

narration.en: Your grandparents bought rice at a few rupees a kilo. To compare prices across years, statisticians use one number: the index number.
narration.kn: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಅಜ್ಜ-ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಕೆಲವೇ ರೂಪಾಯಿಗೆ ಕಿಲೋ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಿದ್ದರು. ವರ್ಷಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಹೋಲಿಸಲು ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರಜ್ಞರು ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಎಂಬ ಒಂದು ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

body.en: An index number is a statistical measure of the relative change in a variable (or a group of variables) over time or place, compared with a base period whose index is 100. For one commodity the price relative is $P = \frac{p_1}{p_0} \times 100$. $P_{01}$ means the index of the current year 1 on base year 0. Types: price index, quantity index and value index.

narration.en: An index number measures relative change compared with a base period, which is given the value one hundred. For one item, the price relative is current price over base price, times one hundred.
narration.kn: ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕವು ಆಧಾರ ಅವಧಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಆಧಾರ ಅವಧಿಯ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ 100. ಒಂದು ವಸ್ತುವಿಗೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ = ಪ್ರಸಕ್ತ ಬೆಲೆ ÷ ಆಧಾರ ಬೆಲೆ × 100.

title.en: One number for a change in price

narration.en: The board places a base year and a current year on a time line and shows how a price relative is built.

say.en: Put the base year on a time line. Its index is always one hundred.
The price relative compares the two prices and scales to one hundred.
One hundred fifty means prices rose by fifty per cent over the base year.
Three kinds of index numbers: price, quantity and value.

narration.en: The price of a kilogram of rice from 2019 to 2024. Each bar is the price relative p₁/p₀ × 100 on the chosen base year, whose own index is always 100. Change the base and watch every index rescale, while the prices stay the same.

caption.en: The price of a kilogram of rice from 2019 to 2024. Each bar is the price relative p₁/p₀ × 100 on the chosen base year, whose own index is always 100. Change the base and watch every index rescale, while the prices stay the same.
caption.kn: 2019 ರಿಂದ 2024 ರವರೆಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕಿಲೋ ಅಕ್ಕಿಯ ಬೆಲೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಂಬ ಆರಿಸಿದ ಆಧಾರ ವರ್ಷದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೆಲೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ p₁/p₀ × 100; ಆಧಾರ ವರ್ಷದ ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ 100. ಆಧಾರ ಬದಲಿಸಿ: ಬೆಲೆಗಳು ಅದೇ, ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳು ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.

tryThis.en: With base 2019, what is the index for 2024? What does it say in words?
Make 2024 the base. Why are all the other bars below 100?
Raise the 2024 price. Which indices change with base 2019, and which with base 2024?

title.en: Constructing an index number: problems and uses

body.en: Steps and problems: (1) purpose of the index; (2) choice of a normal base period; (3) selection of commodities; (4) collection of prices; (5) choice of weights; (6) choice of average (geometric mean is theoretically best); (7) choice of formula. Uses: measuring changes in price level and cost of living, deciding dearness allowance, deflating national income, and guiding policy. Limitations: they are approximate, based on samples, and become outdated as consumption habits change.

points.en: Base year: normal, not too distant

narration.en: To build an index we fix the purpose, a normal base year, the commodities, the prices, the weights, the average and the formula. Index numbers guide wages, dearness allowance and government policy.
narration.kn: ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕ ರಚನೆಗೆ ಉದ್ದೇಶ, ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಧಾರ ವರ್ಷ, ವಸ್ತುಗಳು, ಬೆಲೆಗಳು, ತೂಕಗಳು, ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮತ್ತು ಸೂತ್ರ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಬೇಕು. ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳು ವೇತನ, ತುಟ್ಟಿಭತ್ಯೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸರ್ಕಾರದ ನೀತಿಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗದರ್ಶಿ.

caption.en: Set the base-year and current-year price of one item. The readouts show the price relative and the percentage change.

tryThis.en: Make the current price equal to the base price. What is the index?
If the index is 200, by what per cent did the price rise?
Multiply the two relatives (forward and reverse). What do you get?

narration.en: A price relative is the simplest index number. Move the prices and read the relative.

problem.en: The price of milk was ₹25 per litre in 2015 and ₹45 per litre in 2025. Find the price relative of 2025 on base 2015, and the price relative of 2015 on base 2025.

steps.en: The price of milk rose by 80% from 2015 to 2025.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. The price of milk was ₹25 per litre in 2015 and ₹45 per litre in 2025. Find the price relative of 2025 on base 2015, and the price relative of 2015 on base 2025.
Class quiz. Discuss with your neighbour, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪಕ್ಕದವರೊಂದಿಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ; ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now some questions in the pattern of the II PUC annual examination. Try them before we discuss.

points.en: An index number measures relative change; the base period is 100.
points.kn: ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕವು ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಆಧಾರ ಅವಧಿ 100.

points.en: Choose a normal base year, suitable weights and the geometric mean.
points.kn: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಧಾರ ವರ್ಷ, ಸೂಕ್ತ ತೂಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಾಧ್ಯ ಆರಿಸಿ.

homework.en: Explain any four problems in the construction of index numbers.
State four uses of index numbers.

narration.en: Recap. An index number measures relative change; the base period is 100. Price relative = p₁/p₀ × 100. Choose a normal base year, suitable weights and the geometric mean. Index numbers are economic barometers.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕವು ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಯನ್ನು ಅಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; ಆಧಾರ ಅವಧಿ 100. ಬೆಲೆ ಸಾಪೇಕ್ಷ = p₁/p₀ × 100. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಆಧಾರ ವರ್ಷ, ಸೂಕ್ತ ತೂಕಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಗುಣೋತ್ತರ ಮಾಧ್ಯ ಆರಿಸಿ. ಸೂಚ್ಯಂಕಗಳು ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಮಾಪಕಗಳು.
